correctness.rationale: The Bernoulli row choice closes the coordinate covariance at dimension three. The characteristic polynomial is reconstructed exactly, and the cubic Jury conditions reduce to one sharp factor after proving the other three inequalities. The nondecaying eigenmode is shown to be excited by the source initialization, so covariance instability cannot be dismissed as an unreachable state.

value.rationale: The critical momentum region and Euclidean-error convergence are explicit open questions in the defining KGSM paper. The identity system is the natural baseline where row geometry is eliminated, yet it already exhibits a sharp nontrivial smoothing threshold. The signed-mean blind spot shows that the source observable can certify decay while mean-square error fails, giving a concrete reason why the stronger question matters.
